source: NPWS Site Specific Conservation Objectives ArcGIS FeatureServer SSCO_SAC_Habitats
query_rule: Exact frozen WGS84 target point, esriSpatialRelIntersects, outFields=*, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326.

interpretation_rule.BOTH_HIT: C028 is independently mapped by NPWS as reef and as a named marine community at the exact point; report exact attributes, noting NPWS habitat synthesis partly reviewed INFOMAR plus BioMar/2010 reef survey and is not fully instrument-lineage-independent.
interpretation_rule.REEF_ONLY: Official NPWS reef polygon contains C028 but no marine-community polygon resolves the point.
interpretation_rule.COMMUNITY_ONLY: Marine-community polygon contains C028 without a 1170 reef hit; inspect attributes before interpreting.
interpretation_rule.NONE: No exact NPWS habitat polygon match; do not infer non-reef.
